tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Find published Quantlix pages by words in their title, description or path. Returns canonical URLs and Markdown alternatives. This tool reads public content only.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the Markdown representation of a published Quantlix page using its exact locale-prefixed canonical path with a trailing slash, for example /en/about/. Does not fetch external URLs or private records.
